lines.t: I see what I've become.
To One who paid my ransom.
My love returns anew
as sorrow breaks through!
When I kissed Your Name for show,
it must have been a Judas’ kiss.
When I kept my comfort first,
it probably sounds like mockers’ hiss.
If this is all I gave You.
how did You suffer this long?
If this is all I gave You,
was my love another wrong?
When I chose safe lanes of praise,
it must have stung as nails through wrists
When I ignored their hunger groans,
Did it land like a blow from Roman fist?
When I denied Your living voice,
It must have hurt like Peter’s lie.
When heart denied Your throne,
I joined the mob's "Barabbas!" cries.
By what passion could You bear
The heavy ransom for my price?
When you knew my fickle care.
Would give Your back another stripe?
When I trampled your Feasts,
It must have been another slap.
When I distorted Sabbath Day,
My hand sent dagger's back stab.
If false worship drove the thorn
if my choices made You bleed,
If keeping peace became the lash
Oh, what right have I to plead?
I did this. I did this.
Yes, Lord ,I did this.
I stood where betrayers would stand.
I chose wide path and easy plan.
I gave the lesser things my best,
You gave all, I gave just what's left.
With callous heart, I turned aside.
I sold Your love for selfish pride.
Can You redeem these tears?
Can You mend this or am I too far gone?
Oh, I want you now, My Lord,
I'd rewind each step of my fall,
If false worship left a wound
Can I sooth it with broken call?
My next kiss won't be a weapon.
I betrayed love, I must confess,
Let me kiss Your nail scarred hands,
Let my tears soak though Your chest.
Can You make new my heart?
Oh, Make new my heart!
Only You can mend this…
You can mend this.
All I can offer is tears
and brokenness
